meta.name: understand-dashboard
meta.description: Launch the interactive web dashboard to visualize a codebase's knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 可视化代码库知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要直观浏览代码库的结构和依赖关系。
copy.tagline_en: Visualize your codebase's knowledge graph interactively.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explore your codebase's structure and dependencies visually.

howto.what: 它会在浏览器里打开一个网页,展示项目已有的知识图谱。启动前会检查项目中是否存在图谱数据;没有就提示先运行 /understand,有就在后台启动服务,返回带访问令牌的网址,浏览器自动打开。
howto.when: 当你请求可视化某个项目的知识图谱、或想通过看板查看已有图谱时触发;可附带项目路径。若项目缺少 /understand 生成的图谱文件,它会提示先运行 /understand。

say.text: 启动看板,查看当前项目的知识图谱
say.note: 它会打开网页展示图谱;需要项目里已有图谱文件

say.text: 打开知识图谱看板,路径是 ~/my-project
say.note: 它会用此路径定位项目的图谱数据

say.text: 帮我用知识图谱页面展示一下这个代码库
say.note: 若该项目从未分析,会提示先运行 /understand

howto.what_en: Starts a local web page visualizing the project's knowledge graph. It first checks for existing graph data; if missing, it says to run /understand. Otherwise it launches a background service, returns a tokenized URL, and opens the browser automatically.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to view a project's knowledge graph in a dashboard, optionally passing a project path. It requires the /understand-generated graph file; otherwise it asks you to run /understand first.

say_en.text: Start the dashboard to view the current project's knowledge graph.
say_en.note: It opens a web page after checking for a graph file.
It uses that project path to find the graph data.

say_en.text: Show this codebase as a knowledge-graph page.
say_en.note: If no analysis exists, it suggests running /understand first.
